notes.title: Version 1.1.18
notes.notes:
Patch Notes v1.1.18

🔧General Improvements

Increased the movement speed of the character significantly when in the hub.
A dungeon can now be immediately reentered from the Game Over screen.
In the title menu, it is now possible to decrease the difficulty without losing game progress. But the difficulty cannot be increased afterwards. It is still possible to select a different difficulty when resetting the game.


🌍 Gameplay Changes

Increased the base movement speed of the character inside the dungeons slightly.
Gold is now spawned more frequently during a run, but the amount of gold when finishing a level has been decreased.
Gold values have been increased on the higher tiers.

notes.title: Version 1.1.15
notes.notes:
Patch Notes v1.1.15

🔧 General Improvements

 Minor visual polish and bug fixes.
 Fixed a bug with the Clock artifact.


⚔️ Balance Changes

 Base damage increased for the following weapons:

Staff
Bow
Shuriken
Earth Scepter



🌍 Gameplay Changes

Earth Scepter has been slightly reworked:

Updated visuals and improved functionality.
Increased duration.

Ankh now affects more items:

Certain static projectiles now gain momentum and move directionally.
For example: The shield is no longer bound to the player and now travels in the direction of the companion.

Approaching the portal to "The Void" now displays the percentage value of enemy HP scaling.
